title: JobBKK Jobs Scraper: Thailand Job Listings
description: Scrape job listings from JobBKK, a major Thai job board: title, company, province, salary range, industry, occupation, education, experience and dates. Search by keyword, province and industry. Pay-per-result.
readme:
# JobBKK Jobs Scraper Scrape job listings from JobBKK ([jobbkk.com](https://www.jobbkk.com/)), a major job board in Thailand. You get the title, company, province and district, salary range when shown, industry, occupation, education and experience asked for, and the posting dates for every job. Search by keyword, province and industry. Thai text is kept as it is. ## What you get - One row per job, with clean ISO dates, salary numbers where the employer shows a salary, and the ids behind the names (province, district, occupation, industry). - Optional job page details: exact posting date, closing date, benefits, working days and hours, number of positions, qualifications and the duties as HTML and plain text. Contact details are included only when the job page shows them publicly. - Each job once per run, even when several keywords find it. - A run with no input returns the newest 5 jobs. ## Use with AI Agents (MCP) Connect this actor to any MCP-compatible AI client: Claude Desktop, Claude.ai, Cursor, VS Code, LangChain, LlamaIndex, or custom agents. **Apify MCP server URL:** `https://mcp.apify.com?tools=santamaria-automations/jobbkk-jobs-scraper` **Example prompt once connected:** > "Use `jobbkk-jobs-scraper` to find up to 5 jobs for the keyword "โปรแกรมเมอร์" (programmer roles in Bangkok). Return results as a table with title, company, location and job URL." Clients that support dynamic tool discovery (Claude.ai, VS Code) receive the full input schema automatically. ## Input Every field is optional. Example: ```json { "includeDetails": false, "maxResults": 5, "searchQueries": [ "โปรแกรมเมอร์" ] } ``` | Field | What it does | |---|---| | `searchQueries` | Keywords such as โปรแกรมเมอร์ or sales. Each keyword is its own search. Empty = the newest jobs. | | `province` | Only jobs in this province, written in Thai as on JobBKK, for example กรุงเทพมหานคร or ภูเก็ต. | | `businessId` | Only jobs of this industry. Use the `business_id` of a row from an earlier run. | | `maxResultsPerQuery` | Jobs per keyword. Default 50, up to 1000. | | `maxResults` | Jobs in total. Default 200. 0 means no limit. | | `includeDetails` | Read each job page for the extra fields. Default false. | ## Sample output ```json { "id": "167871/1072536", "company_id": 167871, "job_id": 1072536, "title": "บัญชี", "company_name": "บริษัท เมดิเทคเทรดดิ้ง จำกัด", "company_logo": "https://store.jobbkk.com/upload/employer/0F/FBF/028FBF/images/167871.webp", "job_url": "https://www.jobbkk.com/jobs/detailurgent/167871/1072536", "location": "กรุงเทพมหานคร (เขตบึงกุ่ม)", "province_id": 246, "province_name": "กรุงเทพมหานคร", "district_id": 348, "district_name": "เขตบึงกุ่ม", "province_ids": [ 246 ], "district_ids": [ 348 ], "latitude": 13.838059101546943, "longitude": 100.63836380839348, "bts_station": null, "bts_line_ids": [], "mrt_station": "รามอินทรา ก.ม.6", "mrt_line_ids": [ 10 ], "occupation_id": 17, "occupation_name": "บัญชี", "occupation_sub_id": 299, "occupation_sub_name": "บัญชี", "business_id": 17, "business_name": "พาณิชย์", "job_type": "งานประจำ", "job_format_ids": [ 229 ], "welcome_text": null, "salary_text": "15,000 - 20,000 บาท", "salary_min": 15000, "salary_max": 20000, "salary_currency": "THB", "salary_hidden": false, "salary_period": "MONTH", "education_min": "ปวส.", "education_max": null, "education_min_id": 132, "education_max_id": null, "experience_years_min": 1, "experience_years_max": null, "is_hot": true, "is_urgent": true, "is_new_graduated": false, "is_inexperienced": false, "is_disability": false, "is_toeic": false, "is_all_levels_education": false, "is_corporate": false, "description_text": "บันทึกบัญชีในระบบ Flowaccount ทำใบหัก ณ ที่จ่าย ออกบิลขาย ทำใบสำคัญจ่าย\nรวบรวมเอกสารนำส่งสำนักงานบัญชี", "created_at": "2021-11-09T21:04:14+07:00", "updated_at": "2026-11-10T20:39:03+07:00", "updated_date": "2026-11-10", "posted_text": "1 นาทีที่แล้ว", "details_fetched": true, "date_posted": "2026-11-10T20:35:21+07:00", "valid_through": "2026-11-24T00:00:00+07:00", "employment_type": "FULL_TIME", "description_html": "

Thai or English text is kept as it is. | | `company_name` | string, null | Hiring company name as shown on the listing. | | `company_logo` | string, null | Logo image URL of the company. | | `job_url` | string | Address of the job page on jobbkk.com. | | `location` | string, null | Place text of the listing: province and district. | | `province_id` | integer, null | JobBKK id of the province. | | `province_name` | string, null | Province name (Thai). | | `district_id` | integer, null | JobBKK id of the district. null when the job has no district. | | `district_name` | string, null | District name (Thai). | | `province_ids` | array of integer | Ids of all provinces the job is open in. | | `district_ids` | array of integer | Ids of all districts the job is open in. | | `latitude` | number, null | Latitude of the workplace when the employer gave a map position. | | `longitude` | number, null | Longitude of the workplace when the employer gave a map position. | | `bts_station` | string, null | Nearest BTS (Skytrain) station named on the listing. | | `bts_line_ids` | array of integer | JobBKK ids of the BTS lines of that station. | | `mrt_station` | string, null | Nearest MRT station named on the listing. | | `mrt_line_ids` | array of integer | JobBKK ids of the MRT lines of that station. | | `occupation_id` | integer, null | JobBKK id of the main occupation field. | | `occupation_name` | string, null | Main occupation field (Thai). | | `occupation_sub_id` | integer, null | JobBKK id of the sub field. | | `occupation_sub_name` | string, null | Sub field of the occupation (Thai). | | `business_id` | integer, null | JobBKK id of the industry (business type) of the company. Usable as the businessId input. | | `business_name` | string, null | Industry (business type) of the company (Thai). | | `job_type` | string, null | Job format as shown on the listing, for example full-time or part-time (Thai). | | `job_format_ids` | array of integer | JobBKK ids of the job formats. | | `welcome_text` | string, null | Text such as "fresh graduates welcome" or "no experience needed" when the employer ticked it (Thai). | | `salary_text` | string, null | Salary as shown on the listing, for example "15,000 - 20,000 baht" or "negotiable" (Thai). | | `salary_min` | integer, null | Lower end of the salary in baht. null when the salary is negotiable or hidden. | | `salary_max` | integer, null | Upper end of the salary in baht. null for open-ended pay ("15,000 baht and up") and when the salary is negotiable or hidden. | | `salary_currency` | string, null | THB when salary numbers are given. | | `salary_hidden` | boolean | true when the employer chose not to show the salary (the numbers behind it are not emitted). | | `salary_period` | string, null | Pay period from the job page data, for example MONTH. Needs the job page. | | `education_min` | string, null | Lowest education level asked for (Thai). | | `education_max` | string, null | Highest education level asked for (Thai). | | `education_min_id` | integer, null | JobBKK id of the lowest education level. | | `education_max_id` | integer, null | JobBKK id of the highest education level. | | `experience_years_min` | integer, null | Minimum years of experience. 0 means none needed. | | `experience_years_max` | integer, null | Maximum years of experience. null when there is no upper limit. | | `is_hot` | boolean | Flag "is_hot" of the listing. | | `is_urgent` | boolean | true for urgent listings (the address has detailurgent). | | `is_new_graduated` | boolean | true when fresh graduates may apply. | | `is_inexperienced` | boolean | true when applicants without experience may apply. | | `is_disability` | boolean | Flag "is_disability" of the listing. | | `is_toeic` | boolean | Flag "is_toeic" of the listing. | | `is_all_levels_education` | boolean | true when every education level may apply. | | `is_corporate` | boolean | Flag "is_corporate" of the listing. | | `description_text` | string, null | Job duties as plain text. With the job page, one duty per line. | | `created_at` | string, null | When the listing was first created (ISO 8601, Bangkok time +07:00). | | `updated_at` | string, null | When the listing was last updated or renewed (ISO 8601, Bangkok time +07:00). | | `updated_date` | string, null | Update date shown on the listing (YYYY-MM-DD). | | `posted_text` | string, null | Age of the listing as the site shows it, for example "1 minute ago" (Thai). | | `details_fetched` | boolean | true when the job page was read for this row. | | `date_posted` | string, null | Posting date from the job page data (ISO 8601, +07:00). Needs the job page. | | `valid_through` | string, null | Date the posting stays valid until (ISO 8601, +07:00). Needs the job page. | | `employment_type` | string, null | Employment type from the job page data, for example FULL_TIME. Needs the job page. | | `description_html` | string, null | Job duties as HTML paragraphs, one per line. Needs the job page. | | `responsibilities` | array of string | Duties, one entry per line. Needs the job page. | | `qualifications` | array of string | Knowledge and skills asked for, one entry per line. Needs the job page. | | `benefits` | array of string | Benefits and welfare listed on the job page. Needs the job page. | | `positions_text` | string, null | Number of open positions as written, for example "1 position". Needs the job page. | | `positions_count` | integer, null | Number of open positions. Needs the job page. | | `work_days` | string, null | Working days, for example Monday to Friday. Needs the job page. | | `holidays` | string, null | Days off. Needs the job page. | | `working_hours` | string, null | Working hours, for example 08:30 - 18:00. Needs the job page. | | `position_level` | string, null | Level of the position. Needs the job page. | | `gender` | string, null | Gender asked for ("not specified" when open). Needs the job page. | | `age_range` | string, null | Age range asked for, in years. Needs the job page. | | `education_requirement` | string, null | Education requirement as written on the job page. Needs the job page. | | `experience_requirement` | string, null | Experience requirement as written on the job page. Needs the job page. | | `travel_note` | string, null | How to get to the workplace, as written on the job page. Needs the job page. | | `address_street` | string, null | Street address of the workplace from the job page data. Needs the job page. | | `address_postal_code` | string, null | Postal code of the workplace. Needs the job page. | | `contact_name` | string, null | Contact person shown publicly on the job page. Needs the job page. Values that are masked or need a login are never emitted. | | `contact_phone` | string, null | Contact phone number shown publicly on the job page. Needs the job page. Masked or login-gated values are never emitted. | | `contact_address` | string, null | Contact address shown publicly on the job page. Needs the job page. | | `company_profile_url` | string, null | Company profile page on jobbkk.com. Needs the job page. | | `views_count` | integer, null | Number of views of the job page. Needs the job page. | | `applicants_count` | integer, null | Number of applications the job post has received. Needs the job page. | | `is_unavailable` | boolean | true when the job page says the post is no longer available. Needs the job page. | | `detail_fields` | object, null | Every label and value pair of the job page detail and qualification blocks, with the Thai labels as keys. Needs the job page. | | `search_query` | string | Keyword (or the province, or "all jobs") that found the job. | | `source` | string | Site the job comes from. | | `scraped_at` | string | Time the row was scraped (ISO 8601, UTC). | Fields that a job does not show are `null`, lists are empty lists. The list shows 25 jobs per page. Fields marked "Needs the job page" are `null` or empty when `includeDetails` is off. Times are Bangkok time and carry the +07:00 offset. ## Pricing This Actor uses pay per event. There is a small `apify-actor-start` event when a run starts and one `job-result` event for each job in the dataset. You are never charged for a job twice, and a run stops when it reaches the maximum charge you set. Price: $0.001 start fee per run, then $0.0012 per job result ($1.20 per 1,000 jobs). **New to Apify?** Every account gets a $5 free monthly platform credit, enough to try this actor at no cost. ## Related Actors - [JobKorea Scraper](https://apify.com/santamaria-automations/jobkorea-kr-scraper): Jobs from JobKorea, a major job board in South Korea. - [foundit.in Job Scraper: India, Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia](https://apify.com/santamaria-automations/foundit-in-scraper): Jobs from foundit in India and Southeast Asia. - [Naukri Scraper - India & Middle East Jobs, Salaries, Skills](https://apify.com/santamaria-automations/naukri-scraper): Jobs from Naukri in India and the Middle East. - [Indeed Jobs Scraper - 60+ Countries, $0.06 per 1,000 Jobs](https://apify.com/santamaria-automations/indeed-http-scraper): Indeed jobs in over 60 countries. ## FAQ **How do the province and industry filters work?** The province is sent as part of the JobBKK search address and every row is checked against it: a job counts when its province or location text contains the name you gave. The industry filter is checked on the `business_id` of each row. A value that matches nothing returns 0 jobs. **Why is the salary empty for many jobs?** Many employers choose to show "negotiable" instead of a number. Then `salary_text` says so, `salary_hidden` is true and the numeric fields are `null`. The numbers behind a hidden salary are never emitted. **Are phone numbers and emails included?** Only the contact name, phone and address that the job page shows publicly, and only with `includeDetails` on. Masked values and values that need a login are never emitted. **What happens when a keyword finds nothing?** The run ends normally with the status "0 jobs found for ." and nothing is charged. JobBKK shows suggested jobs on such a page; they are not returned. ## Support Something broken, or a field you wish this Actor returned? Open a ticket on the Actor's [Issues tab](https://apify.com/santamaria-automations/jobbkk-jobs-scraper/issues) or email contact@nanoscrape.com. We usually respond within one working day.
